prompt:

Template: background-reference-sheet-v1. Create reusable spatial canon for an original webtoon location.
Asset ID: school-rooftop-canonical-sheet.
Layout: wide establishing view above, reverse angle and simplified plan-like inset below, plus fixed landmark details.
Required views: north-facing wide establishing view, south-facing reverse angle, greenhouse entrance detail, east-wall bottle shelves, simple spatial plan, rainy dusk lighting variant.
Sheet background: neutral presentation board. Labels: deterministic_overlay.
Preserve exactly: greenhouse door on the south side, rain gutter and bottle shelves fixed to the east wall, low concrete wall overlooking the gray-blue sea, rust-red service stairs entering from the west.
References: none; establish an original design from the declared visual canon.
Standard sheet invariants: fixed entrances, windows, landmarks, circulation paths, horizon, and scale anchors, consistent architecture and material palette across views, clear foreground, midground, and background layers.
Palette swatches: #6f8794, #9ca9aa, #b54e3c, #d6c28e.
Avoid: moving doors between views, impossible stair connection, changing bottle shelf count without story reason, impossible topology, moving landmarks, fisheye unless requested, readable text, watermark, signature.
